Risk-Based Audit Planner
How to use:
1. Select the branch you plan to audit
2. Load or paste its previous audit report(s)
3. Fill in upcoming audit details
4. Click Generate Risk-Based Audit Plan

The system will analyse historical observations, identify high-risk areas, and produce a risk-prioritized audit program with effort allocation and specific procedures for each area.
